atoms = Atoms(
    "Ar2",
    positions=[[0.0, 0.0, 0.0], [4.0, 0.0, 0.0]],
    cell=[12.0, 12.0, 12.0],
    pbc=True,
)
md = MdParameters(
    temperature=100.0,
    time_step=1.0,
    friction_coefficient=0.0,
    thermostat_time_constant=100.0,
    target_pressure=0.0,
    pressure_coupling_time=1.0e10,
    compressibility=4.5e-10,
    minimum_scale_factor=1.0,
    integrator="verlet",
    initialize_momenta=True,
)
particles, systems = md_state_from_ase(atoms, md, key=jax.random.key(7))

print(f"positions: {particles.data.positions.shape}")
print(f"momenta: {particles.data.momenta.shape}")
print(f"masses: {particles.data.masses.shape}")
print(f"cell parameters: {systems.data.cell.frame.tril.shape}")
print(f"JAX leaves in state: {len(jax.tree.leaves((particles, systems)))}")
